numbers.name: maximal_aging
numbers.value: every pushed path ages less, loss quadratic in the push (k = 1, 2, 3, 5)

numbers.name: illustration
numbers.value: vertical rocket (v_e 3000 m/s, mass ratio 8, thrust/weight 1.3) loses 2.02 km/s = 32% to gravity; hovering 1 min costs 588 m/s; hovering 1 t takes 14.7 MW; a clock thrown up for 2 s gains 3.6e-16 s

note: Follows the author's meaning of resisting (2026-11-24): trying to stand still in a moving universe. AI reading: resisting = proper acceleration != 0. Rocket numbers are AI choices, not a real vehicle. Nearest theory: Tsiolkovsky gravity losses, maximal aging of geodesics, gravitational time dilation. Not UET-distinct.
